title: Brick manufacturing
provenance: Manually verified against reference.png, the original user-provided brick-manufacturing chart.

stages.title: Excavate clay
stages.description: Clay is dug from the ground using an excavator.

stages.title: Screen & crush
stages.description: Clay passes through a metal grid and over rollers.

stages.title: Mix ingredients
stages.description: Sand and water are added to the clay.

stages.title: Shape the bricks
stages.description: The mixture is shaped using a mould OR cut with a wire cutter.

stages.title: Dry
stages.description: The newly shaped bricks are dried in an oven.

stages.title: Fire · moderate
stages.description: The dried bricks enter the first kiln stage.

stages.title: Fire · high
stages.description: The bricks are heated at a higher temperature.

stages.title: Cool
stages.description: The fired bricks cool in a cooling chamber.

stages.title: Package
stages.description: The cooled bricks are stacked and packaged.

stages.title: Deliver
stages.description: The packaged bricks are transported by truck.

visualizationNote: Machinery internals, cutaways, mixing, straps and loading motions are illustrative; the source chart specifies the process and facts, not these mechanisms.
